• Follow provided guidelines and instructions for camera placement, activity selection, and safety to ensure data consistency and collection integrity.

• Document, organize, and submit video files in accordance with project specifications, ensuring all deliverables meet technical and quality requirements.

• Communicate proactively and clearly in both written and verbal form regarding progress, questions, and any technical challenges.

• Adapt to occasional updates in collection tasks, environments, or technical requirements as defined by project needs.

Compatible camera examples include:

• Insta360 X3, X4, X5, X6

• DJI Osmo 360

• GoPro MAX, MAX2

• Insta360 Third-Person Backpack Mount and other harness-mounted extension systems.

• Owning a compatible backpack or vehicle mount is a plus and may let you start collecting sooner.

• Mounted above and behind you

• Angled slightly downward

• Positioned far enough back to keep your entire body consistently visible

• Stable enough to maintain the required third-person perspective during normal movement

• Natural everyday activities

• Indoor and outdoor activities

• Walking and moving through different environments

title: Provider Enrollment Specialist
description:
Bridgeview Eye Partners is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Provider Enrollment Specialist to join our Credentialing team. In this role, you’ll play an important part in ensuring our providers and facilities are successfully enrolled with government, managed care, and commercial payers so our patients can continue to receive exceptional eye care without interruption.
If you enjoy managing details, solving problems, working across departments, and keeping complex processes moving forward, this could be a great opportunity for you.
What You’ll Do

• Manage provider and facility payer enrollment applications from preparation through completion, ensuring accuracy and timely submission.

• Collect, review, and verify documentation required for provider and facility enrollments.

• Complete payer enrollment, hospital credentialing, professional licensure, and related applications in accordance with payer requirements and government regulations.

• Maintain accurate information across credentialing and enrollment databases and payer portals, including Availity, CAQH, NaviNet, NPPES, and PECOS.

• Monitor pending applications, identify deficiencies, and work proactively to resolve issues and keep enrollments on track.

• Research and resolve provider and facility enrollment issues by partnering with internal teams and external payer contacts.

• Monitor revalidations, license renewals, and other required updates to ensure providers remain compliant and enrolled.

• Support the Credentialing Manager with new facilities, locations, and providers as Bridgeview Eye Partners continues to expand into new markets.

• Escalate complex or unresolved credentialing and enrollment issues appropriately.

• Provide responsive, professional support to internal stakeholders throughout the enrollment process.

What We Offer

• Competitive hourly wage

• Paid holidays + 2 Floating Holidays

• Approximately 10 days of PTO within first year

• Benefits including medical, dental, & vision

• 401(k)

What We’re Looking For
Required:

• High school diploma or equivalent.

• Minimum of three (3) year experience with provider enrollment.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a highly detail-oriented environment.

• Strong communication and customer service skills.

• Demonstrated accountability, professionalism, and integrity.

Preferred:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.

• Experience with MedTrainer Credentialing software.

• Knowledge of managed care contracts and payer requirements.

Why This Role Matters
Provider enrollment is a critical part of healthcare operations. Your work will help ensure our physicians and other providers are properly enrolled, credentialed, and ready to serve patients across our growing organization.
You’ll collaborate with teams throughout the organization, work with a variety of payers and regulatory systems, and have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact behind the scenes in the delivery of quality patient care.
Position Details
This is a non-exempt role, reporting to the Credentialing Manager, and working in a professional office or remote office environment.
This is primarily a sedentary, computer-based role requiring extended periods of sitting, keyboarding, visual attention to detail, and effective written and verbal communication. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.
